mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 78 degrees with overcast skies across the Military Ridge State Trail, and we currently have a First Quarter moon phase.

The City of Verona is hiring an Engineering Technician to oversee transportation and utility projects through September 20. Additionally, the city has updated its sewer and stormwater utility rates to cover rising maintenance costs, and you can apply for a 30 dollar rain barrel rebate for your property.
We have a packed schedule with Live Music at Bailey's Run and Lake Lou-ee happening today. Tomorrow, you can check out the Dane County Farmer's Market or catch more live music at Paddy Mac's.
In a noteworthy update, on August 15, Verona police officers performed a welfare check on a driver who was found passed out behind the wheel, resulting in an arrest for an O W I.

The delicious Flavor of the Day is Peanut Butter Fudge Brownie, and the shop is open until 10:30 PM. For an extra treat today, you can also catch the Kona Ice truck at the high school football game starting at 6 PM.
